isolation_invariants: records are scoped to the active tenant

invariants.description: Every declared internal navigation URL resolves to an owned or explicitly allowed GET route.
High-risk pages expose stable data-wb-* selectors for primary entities, actions, status badges, filters, modals, and destructive operations.
Every declared internal navigation URL resolves to an owned or explicitly allowed GET route. No sidebar link may drift from registered routes.
Offline pending ledger saves are scoped to the active tenant or module namespace, actor, branch, and business date. Legacy or stale entries are quarantined and never replayed silently.
Sales reporting and summaries derive sales from beg_bal, addtl, withdraw, and bal_end. Historical stored sales values are non-authoritative and must not change reporting semantics.

When formal delivery is enabled, a DR may only be omitted for a server-verified same-location internal release: the destination must be an active commissary configured as local/self-managed production for the product, must not resolve to a distinct supplying commissary, and must be authorized for the actor with the day open. The internal release increments the storefront addtl exactly once, records commissary produced/dispatched, links a dl_production_movements output via commissary_movement_id, stores dr_number = NULL with same_location_internal_release provenance, and never creates a delivery, receiving, or self-delivery. Cross-location output with an empty DR must always be rejected.
POS and stock-derived sales are never summed for the same time segment; summaries expose sales_source, POS total, calculated total, and variance.
Completed POS sale lines and payments are append-only; corrections use linked void/refund documents with actor, role, and reason.
POS never writes beg_bal, addtl, withdraw, bal_end, or dl_daily_ledger.sales.

scenarios.description: Owned pages resolve for declared actors and tenants
Cashier selects POS mode, completes a cash sale, retries the same idempotency key without double-charging, supervisor voids with reason, day closes with reconciliation.
Supervisor records a complete physical checkpoint mid-day; mode switches to fallback and later POS checkout is rejected.
